name: Doutei Help! ~Hatsu Kano no Tame ni Fuuzoku de Tokkun~
original_name: 童貞へるぷ！ ～初カノの為に風俗で特訓～
source:
Welcome to Soapland "Cinderella."
The protagonist, greeted with those words, stiffened up nervously.

His friends were all graduating from their virginity left and right, but he was still a virgin.
Then, out of nowhere, he got his first girlfriend.
They’d been dating for a few months now, but they still hadn’t done anything beyond holding hands.
But he’d heard that modern couples break up quickly if the guy’s bad in bed… and that thought started eating at him.
Around that time, he met a girl from Soapland "Cinderella" and decided to use her to hone his skills.
To satisfy his girlfriend, the virgin protagonist began frequenting a soapland…!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012001.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到肥皂剧“灰姑娘”。
听到这句话，主角紧张地僵住了。

他的朋友们都已经从童贞中毕业了，但他仍然是处女。
然后，不知怎的，他得到了他的第一个女朋友。
他们已经交往了几个月了，但是除了牵手之外，他们还没有做过任何事情。
但他听说现代情侣如果床上功夫不好的话很快就会分手……这个想法开始困扰着他。
大约在那个时候，他遇到了一个来自肥皂剧“灰姑娘”的女孩，并决定利用她来磨练他的技能。
为了满足女友，处男主角开始经常光顾肥皂剧……！
